verdict.rationale: Atlas documents creating, sending, and tracking SAFEs from the Dashboard. It also provides legal documents developed with Cooley, which suggests standard-template terms rather than drafting from scratch. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions e-signing the SAFE, and convertible notes are not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: explicit documented signing/execution flow, confirmation that the SAFE templates use standard terms, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SAFE workflow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate and sign SAFEs or convertible notes on standard terms without drafting from scratch

citations.quote: Learn how you can fundraise for your startup by creating, sending, and tracking Simple Agreements for Future Equity (SAFEs) from your Dashboard.
It also gives you access to legal documents developed with Cooley (a law firm for startups)
